notes.title: Patch 2.0
notes.content:
[olist]
 World 1 and 2 are now available in the base game. Woohoo!
 Multiple achievement fixes for Coin achievements and Parkour achievements. Parkour achievements use new data so will need players to play levels again to get them. 
[/olist]

notes.title: Patch 1.4
notes.content:
Add link to the Discord - Join to keep up with any updates and chat with fellow gamers :)
 Remove ability to jump and boost with the left joystick on gamepad

notes.title: Win 1 of 10 FREE Cartoon Survivor DLC Keys
notes.content:
We're giving away 10 free DLC keys!
Think you've got what it takes to win? All you have to do is play the base game of Cartoon Survivor and share your best time with us! 

Here's how to enter:
1. Play Cartoon Survivor2. Finish Episode 3: Dinorama3. Share a screenshot of your best time (Steam community/Discord)


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45578624/37fbbae0a75cda39f53345953e46f268115a53b4.jpg"]

Share your best time (like the screenshot above) in the Cartoon Survivor Steam community or the Spunge Games Discord Server and the 10 fastest times will win free DLC keys!



Join the Spunge Games Discord Server



10 winners will be chosen on 21st August 2025 at 10am AEST.  Best of luck!
